slides.headline: He was born in India. In October 2026, he was elected mayor of a Canadian mountain town.
Harshan Ramadass was elected Mayor of Fernie, British Columbia, on October 17, 2026
slides.body: He won with 54.5% of the vote - 1,524 votes to fellow councillor Kyle Hamilton's 1,194 - in BC's 2026 municipal elections, after previously serving as a Fernie city councillor.

slides.headline: He's one of at least two Indo-Canadian leaders elected mayor in British Columbia's 2026 local elections.
slides.body: From city councillor to mayor, his path shows how deeply Indian-origin leaders are now embedded in municipal government in small-town Canada, not just its major cities.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when India-born leaders run town councils as readily as tech companies.
slides.body: Ramadass's win is a reminder that Indian-origin political representation abroad now reaches well beyond national capitals and major metros.
